subject.value: Pneumatic – Engine Bleed Air System – Modification Aircraft Flight Manual – Amendment
subject.raw_text: ATA 36 – Pneumatic – Engine Bleed Air System – Modification Aircraft Flight Manual – Amendment

applicability_groups.label: A350 applicability stated in the AD
applicability_groups.raw_text: Applicability: Airbus A350-941 and A350-1041 aeroplanes, all manufacturer serial numbers, except those on which Airbus modification (mod) 113759 has been embodied in production.
exclusions: except those on which Airbus modification (mod) 113759 has been embodied in production

definitions.definition_text: Airbus A350 Aircraft Flight Manual (AFM) Temporary Revision (TR) 114 issue 1.
Airbus SB A350-31-P028 for aeroplanes fitted with FWS standard S4/2.0, and Airbus SB A350-31-P029 for aeroplanes fitted with FWS standard S5/2.2, as applicable.

unsafe_condition.raw_reason_text: Reason: A misbehaviour in the establishment of the Flight Warning System logic can cause the AIR APU BLEED LEAK ECAM alert to trigger several times, requiring repeated engine 1 bleed resets. Each reset exposes structural parts to hot air for several seconds. If not corrected, critical locations and surrounding structure can be exposed to heat stress, possibly reducing aeroplane structural integrity. Airbus issued AFM TR 114 with an updated AIR APU BLEED LEAK procedure. The ATQC installations described in FOT 999.0062/18 are required by EASA AD 2018-0213 for a different unsafe condition and are not mandated again by this AD. This AD requires only amendment of the applicable AFM.
observed_events_or_defects: The AIR APU BLEED LEAK ECAM alert can trigger several times, leading the flight crew to perform repeated engine 1 bleed resets.
causes: Misbehaviour in the establishment of the Flight Warning System logic.
unsafe_conditions: Each engine 1 bleed reset exposes structural parts to hot air for several seconds, subjecting critical locations and surrounding structure to heat stress.
potential_consequences: Reduced structural integrity of the aeroplane.
affected_components: Flight Warning System logic and AIR APU BLEED LEAK ECAM alert
Critical structural locations and surrounding structure exposed during bleed resets
intended_risk_mitigation: Amend the applicable AFM with the updated AIR APU BLEED LEAK procedure, inform flight crews, and operate in accordance with that procedure.

requirements.action_text: (1) Within 30 days after the effective date of this AD, amend the applicable AFM to incorporate Airbus A350 AFM TR 114, inform all flight crews, and thereafter operate the aeroplane accordingly. If ECAM-displayed procedures and the applicable AFM differ, the AFM procedures prevail.
objects_or_components: Applicable Airbus A350 Airplane Flight Manual
AIR APU BLEED LEAK operating procedure
conditions: If procedures displayed on the ECAM differ from the applicable AFM, the AFM procedures prevail

compliance_rules.raw_text: (1) Within 30 days after the effective date of this AD, amend the applicable AFM to incorporate Airbus A350 AFM TR 114, inform all flight crews, and thereafter operate the aeroplane accordingly. If ECAM-displayed procedures and the applicable AFM differ, the AFM procedures prevail.

exceptions.text: Amending the applicable AFM to incorporate a later AFM revision that includes AFM TR 114 is acceptable to comply with REQ-001.

EASA AD No.: 2018-0246 the flight crew performs an engine 1 bleed reset, structural parts are exposed to hot air for several seconds. This condition, if not corrected, could lead to exposure of critical locations and surrounding structure to heat stress, possibly resulting in reduced structural integrity of the aeroplane. To address this potential unsafe condition, Airbus issued the AFM TR to provide an updated procedure «AIR APU BLEED LEAK» operations, and Flight Operations Transmission (FOT) 999.0062/18, informing operators that Airbus provides two different Temporary Quick Changes (ATQC) to the ECAM, as applicable, depending on the installed FWS standard, either STD S4/2.0 or STD S5/2.2. Installation of that ATQC is already required by EASA AD 2018-0213, related to a different unsafe conditionand is therefore not mandated again by this AD. For the reasons described above, this AD requires only the amendment of the applicable AFM to update the procedures related to «AIR APU BLEED LEAK» operations.

(2) Amending the applicable AFM to incorporate a later AFM revision, which includes the AFM TR as required by paragraph (1) of this AD, is acceptable to comply with the requirements of paragraph (1) of this AD. Note 1: In case any discrepancy is identified between procedures displayed on the ECAM and procedures stated in the applicable AFM, the AFM procedures prevail.
